items.text: MP3 guide table e, ar tumi phone e? Order! Order! Ei adalot e reels er kono jamin nai. 😼
Dawat e biryani khaowar shomoy chachi jiggesh korbe 'BCS er result kobe?' Answer ready rakho: 'Porashona korle shiggiri.' Ekhon poro!
Facebook e 'BCS preparation tips' scroll korle preparation hoy na, boss. Boi ta kholo.
Ami ekta biral, tobu tomar cheye beshi article mone ache. Lojja! Bolo to, Article 137 ki niye?
Cha break? Already 3 cup sesh. Ar ekta khele tumi BCS cadre na, tea-stall cadre hoye jabe. ☕
Notification ashle ami gavel mari. Thak! Thak! Thak! Ekhon shudhu tumi, boi, ar ami.
Prelim e shob MCQ te 'none of the above' tick dewa strategy na, eta surrender. Poro!
Relatives: 'Pasher basar chele to admin cadre!' Tumi: still page 12 e. Cholo, page 13 e jai.
Ghum pacche? Ami biral, dine 16 ghonta ghumai. Kintu BCS ami dicchi na, tumi dicchho. Utho!
Phone ta ekhon hostage, ar tumi amar adalot e. Bail chaile shame confession type korte hobe. Bhebe dekho. 😼
Puro page holud highlight korle shob mone thake na. Age poro, bujho, tarpor highlight. Holud kalir oporadh bondho!
Instagram tomake cadre banabe na. Kintu ei 25 minute banate pare. Choose wisely, counsel.
Professor's guide er ojon shune bhoy peyo na. Protidin ektu ektu khao, biryani er moto.
Tumi aaj onek porecho. Ektu pani khao, kandh ta relax koro. Magistrate Meow tomar pashei ache. 🐾
Every page you finish today is one less page between you and that cadre badge. Keep going.
Bhul hole problem nai. Bhul theke shekha jinish-i beshi mone thake. Next question e cholo.
A tired brain is still learning. Choto choto step, kintu protidin. That's how cadres are made.
Ekta deep breath nao: 4 second in, 4 second dhore rakho, 4 second out. Ebar abar shuru.
You don't have to be perfect, just consistent. Aaj er session ta sesh koro, ami proud hobo.
Shob aspirant ei klanti feel kore. Tumi ekla na. Ektu ektu kore, tumi parbe.
Your family's hopes are real, but so is your effort. Respect your own hard work today.
Mone koro keno shuru korechile. Oi shopno ta ekhono tomar-i.
Small wins count: one article, one strait, one date. Aaj tumi onek gulo jitecho.

items.topicTag: Rest is part of the plan
items.text: Rest is part of the plan, not a betrayal of it. Session sesh hole ektu hat-pa nariye nio.
BCS ekta marathon, sprint na. Stamina rakho, ar nijer proti ektu doya rakho.
